plain_statement: A projective plane of order q given as an incidence relation on N = q^2+q+1 points and N lines; C a circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, on the 2N inputs, true at every incident point-line pair and false at every input with at most q lines on and no incident pair on, q at least 2. Then C has at least 2q^2+1 OR gates.
